mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM idevelop_zfit_xt_cwzt izxc LEFT join idevelop_dept id on izxc.swerk = id.erp_unit_code LEFT join idevelop_hardware_basic_tree ihbt on izxc.sbfl = ihbt.erp_code where id.is_deleted = 0 and id.type = 'CORP' and id.region_code like CONCAT(#{region}, '%') and ihbt.device_claccify = #{category}
SELECT * FROM `idevelop_dept` where type = 'CORP' and is_deleted = 0 and region_code like concat(#{region},'%') ORDER BY region_code
SELECT * FROM `idevelop_dept` where type = 'CORP' and is_deleted = 0 and region_code like concat('37','%') and length(region_code)=4 and region_code <> '3718' ORDER BY region_code
